gen-gf-bpmf-iansui-fs-literata: Relaxed and hand-drawn, Bpmf Iansui moves in one smooth, toothpaste-squeezed line across the top. And Literata, a classic serif with sturdy thin strokes and slightly heavier thick ones, carries a longer read with a bookish steadiness.
gen-gf-cause-fs-literata: Literata is the bookish half, a text serif whose curved letters keep their mouths wide open and whose thick-thin shift stays mellow. But Cause is the friendlier hand, with diagonals as stout as its upright strokes, so it speaks up where Literata settles in to be read.
gen-gf-chilanka-fs-bespoke-sans: Chilanka writes every stroke at a single thickness, with apertures that keep each counter linked to the space outside. But Bespoke Sans is the sharper tool, a sans with generous gaps between curve ends and stems that holds text crisply.
gen-gf-comic-neue-fs-bespoke-sans: Casual and rope-thin, Comic Neue sketches its curves without any thinning, while Bespoke Sans stands beside it, sharp and refined. A plain sans this open keeps a long page easy on the eye.
gen-gf-comic-neue-fs-literata: Literata brings a sophisticated, bookish weight, its thin strokes still respectable beside Comic Neue's pipe-cleaner lines. Literata then carries a long page with sturdy thin lines, swelling thicks and curves that open wide.
gen-gf-coming-soon-archivo: Coming Soon builds its letters from a ring-like o with a constant wall, no calligraphic swelling anywhere, and a lowercase that climbs near the capitals. Archivo adds the commanding height.
gen-gf-coming-soon-fs-asap: Readable and tidy, Asap keeps its c forms as open arcs and its lowercase nearly as tall as the capitals. Asap then sits under Coming Soon's glass-tube lettering, where the hollow, constant-thickness strokes feel casual against a sans that stays put.
gen-gf-coming-soon-fs-epilogue: Loose handwriting meets wire-thin curves here. Coming Soon is best at casual, personal lettering, while Epilogue, a sans-serif with tall-bodied lowercase and stubby ascender tips, does its best work as the contemporary, approachable text underneath.
gen-gf-coming-soon-fs-erode: Coming Soon draws its lines with no heavier downstrokes, each o a ring with a constant wall, like pen-and-paper handwriting. Erode, a text serif, does the dignified editorial reading.
gen-gf-coming-soon-fs-fira-sans: A ring of an o with a constant wall marks Coming Soon, scribbled in casual, personal pen-and-paper letters. But Fira Sans, a sans with a larger-than-usual x-height and wide-open s curves, does the clean, professional work of carrying text.
